four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: partial -- dACC carries UNSIGNED surprise (Hayden 2011) and momentary affect is a leaky integral OVER prediction errors (Rutledge 2014); both are in targeted_review_connectome_mech_055. REE computes the harm PE as the residual of a forward model OF the leaky integrator itself (z_harm_a = encoder(EMA alpha 0.05 of proximity fields, persistent across episodes, + harm history len 10)). Biology places the integrator DOWNSTREAM of the PE, so a converged forward model of the integrator sitting at persistence is what the reference predicts, not an anomaly.

suggested_probes.sketch: on the SAME ticks, score an ensemble-disagreement PE (K converged heads, different inits, driver-local -- NOT the SD-PP-B11 producer) against the residual-head PE of a CONVERGED head (1077's fitter), with an exposure-matched baseline; DV = separation of each PE source from the VALENCE_HARM level. design_audit_notes: Verdict-aliasing: once the head sits at persistence, residual-head PE ~= raw innovation |z(t)-z(t-1)|, so an 'innovation-variance' source is NOT an independent alternative -- make it a named baseline arm, and ensemble disagreement (or an input-level PE on the fast proximity field) the alternative.
Do not score the ONLINE head's residual PE as the comparator: it is model error (1077), so any alternative beats it trivially.

Carry 1077's in-sample bound + permuted twin, plus a within-eval-distribution episode-split held-out fit, as recorded non-gating readouts so a null can be read as 'nothing learnable' vs 'learnable but not learned'.
Record the converged head's action sensitivity (1062a's H3b elimination rested on the ONLINE head's).

No BEHAVIOURAL DV for the harm PE is admissible under the 1062a config: candidate_effort is uniform (trajectory length at config.horizon) and dacc_foraging_weight is 0, so the PE is a candidate-uniform shift that cannot change an action. Keep the DV a readout.

The driver's epsilon override is applied AFTER select_action, whose internal e2_harm_a rollforward uses the pre-override action; on ~10% of eps-0.1 ticks the dACC PE is computed against a prediction for an action not taken. Score the PE the next leg studies from post-override pairs, or evaluate at eps 0.
In-sample statuses are inadmissible on their own: the permuted twin itself reads ready on 2/3 seeds at eps 0.1; only real-vs-twin separation is readable.
